name: Pathaleon the Calculator
shortDescription: Pathaleon the Calculator, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Named as holder of the Bottom Shard of the Arcatraz Key in the Mechanar. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
